data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Justinos', meaning 'Just'. This name was popular among early Christians and is derived from the root 'dikaios' meaning 'righteous, just'. The name Justinn carries the meaning “Righteous, Just” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Justinn usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous, just and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In Christian tradition, the name Justinn is often seen as a symbol of moral integrity and virtue.

It is a reminder of the importance of being just and fair in all aspects of life, following the teachings of Jesus and striving to live a holy and virtuous life.
